title: Recycling Clothes
passage: Many people buy new clothes and throw away old ones. Some clothing stores now collect used clothes from their customers. These stores recycle the clothes into new products, and by doing so, they help to reduce waste. Such efforts are becoming more important as more people think about the environment.

no1.question: According to the passage, how do some clothing stores help to reduce waste?
no1.modelAnswer: By collecting used clothes from customers and recycling them into new products.
keyPoints: 客から古着を回収する（collect used clothes）ことに触れている
それを新しい製品にリサイクルする（recycle into new products）ことを述べている
